title: A chat-history file that failed to open stays unopened for the page's life, so History never shows its conversations until a reload or an erase
evidence: Codex R1 on PR 1643 (2026-11-13). chat-history-access.ts open() caches a failed open as null (store = opening.catch(() => null), :46-53) and getChatHistory reuses that session (:80-83) unless the erase identity moves (cached, :63-77). listConversations (chat-api.ts:150-155) then falls through to the server list, which answers a sessionless local-first visitor with an empty list, so the reducer marks the list read and C26's retry never runs. US-15 AC47a records the kept null as today's behaviour. A fix (re-open on the next read after a failed open) touches the erase fences (US-11 AC2g, AC2h): the owner's call.
